title: owned, redis, through, strict
summary: A shared Redis with a recorded maxmemory and allkeys-lru policy (approximate LRU, and the report says so). Write-through: the new value is never published before the database commit; the writer tombstones, commits, then republishes only the committed representation. A read that begins after a write to that key was acknowledged must not return an older value; a violation fails the cell. The owned model supplies a monotonic cache_version to fence and validate against.
risk: MUST record zero stale-after-ack reads and zero impossible cache values; a single wrong read invalidates the cell for performance conclusions
